page.content:
AD Archie, known as the AD Fujita (ＡＤ 藤田) in the Japanese version, is a character in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! Dungeon Dice Monsters. He is based on A.D. Fujita from the Yu-Gi-Oh! manga.

page.overview:
Who is AD Archie?

AD Archie, known as the AD Fujita (ＡＤ 藤田) in the Japanese version, is a character in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! Dungeon Dice Monsters. He is based on A.D. Fujita from the Yu-Gi-Oh! manga.

Archie's Crest Pool consists of Beast, Spellcaster and Zombie monsters.
